subtitle: Bike rides that clear your fog.

apps.name: Unfog
apps.subtitle: Bike rides that clear your fog.
apps.localizedDescription: Turn-by-turn bike routes that take you down streets you haven't ridden yet. Reads Been To and Fog of World, writes a Sync folder back, and plans rides to 100% of any neighborhood.

versions.localizedDescription: Explored ground now glows mint and finished streets are drawn, with a legend. Streets load from a tiled cache so a second request no longer re-downloads everything, the map servers are asked in parallel, and fill-in plans on every core with a time cap. A new plan replaces one still in progress instead of getting stuck behind it. Unfog can write its Sync folder straight into iCloud Drive › beento › import.

Been To backups import correctly. Connect Been To's automatic backups folder to sync on every launch; hand-imported backups merge instead of replacing. New Sync folder at On My iPhone › Unfog › Fog of World › Sync for Been To to read.

privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Unfog plans rides from where you are and gives turn-by-turn directions, including with the screen locked in your pocket.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: With Always on, Unfog keeps giving directions and logging your ride when the phone is locked or another app is open.
